entities.title: Online game messages
entities.summary: What a Hivestorm browser sends the other player through the games hub's relay.
consumers: The other player's browser, running the same version of Hivestorm
The games hub's relay, which passes messages on in order
guarantees: start: { slots, seed, delay, ticket }, sent by the host; ticket is the server-issued { id, seed } or null
in: { f, b }, the sender's controls from step f on, each the bits left 1, right 2, fire 4
sum: { f, h }, a fingerprint of step f (the frame, the ship, the turn, the aliens left, the sway, the shot, the bullets, each player's score and ships, and the generator's state)
rtt: { ms }, the sender's round trip, when it changes by 5 ms or more
name: { player, name }, a player's name for the table, or null
table: { highlight }, the table rows (0 to 9) the host's submission made
entities.compatibility: start, in, sum and rtt come from src/online.ts, which is the same file in Rally and Shatterbelt and changes with them (Rally's online-messages contract). The ticket on start, name and table, and what is packed into in and fingerprinted into sum, are Hivestorm's own: both browsers must run the same build.
